description: The Global Volcanic Radiative Power (VRP) Dataset: Twenty-Five Years of Middle InfraRed Satellite Observations (2000–2025) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by D. Coppola et al. We present a global dataset of Volcanic Radiative Power (VRP) derived from Mid-InfraRed (MIR) satellite observations at 170 active volcanoes worldwide between 2000 and 2025. The dataset includes VRP measurements derived from the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) and the Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS), processed using the Middle InfraRed Observation of Volcanic Activity (MIROVA) system. Coverage: global; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
